summary: Frontend-only testing of premium one-page portfolio for Flamur Ahmeti. All 14 acceptance criteria pass: loader transition, hero name, rotating role, mailto CTAs, smooth scroll, About stats, Project cards with correct external hrefs + target=_blank, 16 tech pills, 6 social links, contact mailto + copy-to-clipboard state, footer, cursor-glow + particles in DOM, responsive (desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844), and no console/page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Socials section: GitHub/LinkedIn/X links point to root domains (https://github.com/, https://www.linkedin.com/, https://x.com/) instead of Flamur Ahmeti's actual profiles. Handles shown (flamur-ahmeti, in/flamur-ahmeti, @flamur_ahmeti) are decorative only — consider updating href values to real profile URLs once provided by user.

Particles is rendered unconditionally for both mobile and desktop. CursorGlow is hidden on mobile via 'hidden md:block' which is good; consider also gating Particles count on viewport for perf on low-end mobiles (minor).
MagneticButton: when href is an in-page anchor like '#projects' (non-http), target/rel remain undefined which is correct. OK.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static one-page portfolio. Loader fades after 1.6s; wait ~3s before asserting on hero. Hero rotates roles every 2.6s. Social links currently point to root domains (intentional placeholders per user spec — only Shopify, App Store, and Web have real URLs). Clipboard copy works in Playwright when permissions are granted via context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write']).
